_meanings:
²1 To sit down, take a seat; {#evamuktvA'rjunaH saMKye raTopasTa upAviSat#} <ls>Bg. 1. 47</ls>.
.²2 To sit near to, wait upon.
.²3 To pitch a camp, encamp.
.²4 To go down, set (as the sun).
.²5 To enter upon, practise; as {#prAyam upaviSati#}; so {#anaSanopavizwa#}.
.²6 To abstain from food, fast; {#so'pyuktvEvamupAviSat#} <ls>Bk. 7. 75</ls>.
.²7 To seize, take possession of.

To cause to sit down,
 place or set down.
